UserSyncProfile.title: UserSyncProfile
UserSyncProfile.description: Encrypted cloud sync profile metadata for an authenticated user without storing sensitive PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

deviceCount.description: Number of registered Android/web devices syncing to this profile (1..50).

activeDeviceId.description: Identifier of the most recently synced device.

keyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the client-side encryption key for verification across devices.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the sync profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync profile update.

EncryptedSyncRecord.title: EncryptedSyncRecord
EncryptedSyncRecord.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted payload synced across user devices (preferences, thresholds, monthly health reports, pinned telecom sites).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the record owner.

deviceId.description: Device identifier that produced this encrypted snapshot.

androidApiLevel.description: Android API level (26 = Android 8.0 Oreo minimum up to 36).

saltBase64.description: Base64-encoded PBKDF2 salt used for key derivation.

checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 digest of ciphertext for integrity verification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest snapshot sync.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores per-user sync profile metadata keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/encryptedSnapshots/{snap.description: Stores client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted cloud sync snapshots scoped strictly to the owning user.
